title: wg: partial-02 L479 Nothing requires receiver_membership_proof_after.leaf_index to equal...
description:
draft-ietf-mls-partial (partial-02), Annotated Commit. Editors' copy mlswg/mls-partial at 7fef7c1, L479.

Text: "2. Verify that the `sender_membership_proof_after` and
   `receiver_membership_proof_after` reference the same tree, and that they are
   valid relative to `tree_hash_after`."

Problem: Nothing requires receiver_membership_proof_after.leaf_index to equal the client's own leaf index. For member Commits, nothing requires sender_membership_proof_after.leaf_index to equal the committer's index. The LCA and update_path_index are then computed from proofs that may describe different leaves, and the derived path secrets can be stored against the wrong nodes.

Suggested fix: Add MUSTs: receiver_membership_proof_after.leaf_index equals the client's own leaf index, and sender_membership_proof_after.leaf_index equals the committer's leaf index (Sender.leaf_index for member Commits).

Severity: low. Verifier: narrow (The missing checks are real. A wrong sender or receiver leaf usually yields a wrong commit_secret, which the confirmation_tag check catches. The residual risk is silent mis-assignment of the derived path keys, so this is low severity, not medium.)

From MLS audit workflow wf_581e61f8-b25 (2026-10-21). Not yet reviewed by Mark; nothing posted upstream.
